name: FT-891 QUICK DIAL Fine Steps
note: Expands Menu 14-01 QUICK DIAL (the MULTI-knob VFO tuning step in SSB/CW/RTTY/DATA) from the stock 3 options (50/100/500 kHz) to 6 ascending options: 1/5/10/50/100/500 kHz, with full CAT EX1401 read/write parity for the new range. Value ordering is chosen so value 2 = 10 kHz = the stock factory-default byte, so the power-on/reset default becomes 10 kHz with no defaults-table edit. Supersedes ft891_quickdial_1khz. Contains ONLY the mod author's code (cave routines + repoint bytes) and generic ASCII menu labels; no Yaesu firmware bytes. Apply to your own official firmware .bin. Sources: qd_step6.s, qd_inc6.s, qd_dec6.s, qd_cat_wr.s, qd_cat_rd.s.

regions.note: Menu 14-01 inc stub -> jmp qd_inc6(0x2f160); 3-bit field, clamp 5
Menu 14-01 dec stub -> jmp qd_dec6(0x2f180); 3-bit field, clamp 0

Menu 14-01 label render: repoint branch from shared and#3 index-mask (0x131da) to an and#7 snippet (0x135ce) so values 4/5 index qd_labels as 100kHz/500kHz instead of aliasing (4&3=0,5&3=1) to 1kHz/5kHz
QUICK DIAL step selector entry (SSB/CW/RTTY/DATA): jmp qd_step6(0x2f1a0)
Menu 14-01 CAT-write stub: bra shared-validator(0x16586) -> jmp qd_cat_wr(0x2f2a0); accepts 0..5
Menu 14-01 CAT-read stub: bra shared-formatter(0x17368) -> jmp qd_cat_rd(0x2f2d0); reports 0..5
cave: qd_labels, 6 x 15-byte space-padded ASCII ('1kHz','5kHz','10kHz','50kHz','100kHz','500kHz'), 90 B
cave: qd_cat_wr (CAT EX1401 write, accepts 0..5, 3-bit store), 44 B
regions.comment: tail-jumps to shared CAT completion 0x15a9a (ok) / 0x15a96 (reject); parser 0x19716

regions.note: cave: qd_cat_rd (CAT EX1401 read, 3-bit mask), 8 B
